_comment: DYST global settings. Every value here can be overridden per media file with a same-named sidecar (.json/.txt next to the media). Key order groups: Core loop -> Media & playback -> Audio -> Display & layout -> Chroma key -> System; related keys stay adjacent. Every key is explained in the _hints block at the bottom, including how it interacts with the per-file sidecar keys (see config_template.json for the per-file reference). Bad values are ignored with a warning, never crash the app.

_hints.tick_seconds: Seconds between chance rolls. Each tick rolls 1-in-`odds`. Must be > 0. Interacts with `odds` (how often a tick CAN hit) and `max_concurrent` (how many plays one tick may burst). Default 1.0.
_hints.odds: 1-in-N chance per tick (1000 = 0.1% every tick). Lower = more frequent. Must be >= 1. Interacts with `tick_seconds` (overall frequency) and `max_concurrent` (burst cap). Default 1000.
_hints.max_concurrent: Maximum overlays allowed on screen at once; 0 = unlimited. Also caps the same-tick re-roll burst. Counts only currently-playing overlays. Default 3. (This is the single concurrency key; the old `max_on_screen` was a duplicate and was removed.)
_hints.play_once: true = do not start the same media file again while any copy of it is already playing. Per-file `play_once` can override this. Default false.
_hints.reroll_in_same_tick: Reserved for forward-compat: on a success the ticker ALWAYS re-rolls in the same tick (burst) up to `max_concurrent`. v1 is locked to true; changing this value currently has no effect. Default true.
_hints.media_folder: Media root scanned for content. Relative paths resolve from the app folder (absolute allowed). `media/images/` and `media/videos/` are scanned; each file's sidecar audio + per-file settings live in the same subfolder. Default 'media'.
_hints.download_max_height: Only used by scripts/download_videos.py: maximum video height (px) to download. The CLI's 3rd argument overrides this. Default 1080.
_hints.rescan_seconds: While the daemon runs, re-scan `media_folder` every N seconds so newly added/removed files are picked up. 0 = scan once at startup only. Default 60.
_hints.image_display_seconds: How long a still image (or GIF/APNG/WebP animation) stays on screen before fading out. Images only; videos run to their end (unless `max_duration` caps them). A per-file `duration` (or per-file `image_display_seconds`) overrides this. Default 1.0.
_hints.end_on_audio_end: IMAGES/GIFs only. true = ignore the display timer and keep the image up until its sidecar audio ENDS, then fade out. No sidecar audio = no effect (normal timer runs). `max_duration` still applies and wins over a long audio track. Per-file value overrides this. Default false.
_hints.fade_in_seconds: Fade-in duration (seconds) before the display clock starts: opacity 0 -> base opacity. Images/GIFs only; videos ignore it. Adds to the lifetime (fade_in + display + fade_out). Per-file value overrides this; 0 = off. Default 0.
_hints.fade_out_seconds: Fade-out duration (seconds) at the end of an image/GIF. Videos end instantly (no fade). Renamed from 'fade_seconds' (the old name is still accepted as a deprecated alias). Per-file value overrides this; 0 = instant. Default 0.2.
_hints.max_duration: Hard cap (seconds) on ANY overlay AND its audio. When it fires, the visual + audio stop immediately, with NO fade-out, and the overlay closes. 0 = no cap (play to the natural end). A per-file `max_duration` wins over this; a per-file 0 explicitly disables the global cap. Default 0.
_hints.speed: Playback speed multiplier (> 0). Scales video frame rate + own audio, GIF animation, sidecar audio, and image display time + fades (all timings / speed). 2 = twice as fast. Overridden by `speed_pitch` when that is > 0, and by the per-file value. When `pitch` == 1, audio speeds tape-style (pitch follows speed). Default 1.
_hints.pitch: Audio pitch multiplier (> 0), independent of speed. Applies to sidecar audio and to video audio (the embedded track is extracted + re-encoded; needs ffmpeg when != 1). Overridden by `speed_pitch` when that is > 0, and by the per-file value. Default 1.
_hints.speed_pitch: Combined speed+pitch multiplier (>= 0). When > 0 it sets BOTH `speed` and `pitch` to this value and OVERRIDES the individual `speed`/`pitch` keys (global and per-file). 0 = off (use speed/pitch separately). Per-file value wins over this. Default 0.
_hints.max_playback_height: Performance cap (px): media taller than this is downscaled (aspect kept) BEFORE decode/chroma-key/copy/paint, so high-res clips play smoothly. Videos + GIFs; still images ignore it. 0 = no cap (native). Per-file value overrides this. Changing it rebuilds that video's precache. Default 480.
_hints.max_playback_fps: Performance cap: effective playback framerate for videos. Sources above it are frame-sampled (duration and audio untouched). GIFs ignore it. 0 = no cap. Per-file value overrides this. Changing it rebuilds that video's precache. Default 30.
_hints.volume: Master volume/gain 0.0-5.0 (1.0 = 100%; > 1 boosts). The per-file `volume` MULTIPLIES this: final = global * per-file, so a per-file 0.5 halves it and 2 doubles it. Needs audio (sidecar or the video's own track). Default 0.8.
_hints.monitor: Which screen overlays appear on: 'primary' or a 0-based monitor index. Default 'primary'.
_hints.mode: Default way media covers the screen: fit (whole media visible, aspect kept, centered) | stretch (squish to exactly the screen) | cover-height (fit screen width, crop top/bottom) | cover-width (fit screen height, crop left/right) | custom (use position/scale/flip/rotation below). A per-file `mode` overrides this. The removed 'cover' value falls back to 'fit'. Default 'fit'.
_hints.opacity: Overlay transparency 0.0-1.0 applied to the whole window (1.0 = fully opaque). Fades compose on top (fade-in runs 0 -> opacity, fade-out runs opacity -> 0). Per-file value overrides this. Default 1.0.
_hints.position_x: Custom mode only (when `mode` is 'custom'). Normalized horizontal placement, clamped to -1..2: 0 = media's left edge at the screen's left edge, 1 = right edge at the right edge, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 pushes it off-screen (peek/crop). Per-file value overrides this. Default 0.5.
_hints.position_y: Custom mode only. Normalized vertical placement, clamped to -1..2: 0 = media's top edge at the screen's top edge, 1 = bottom edge at the bottom edge, 0.5 = centered; outside 0..1 pushes it off-screen. Per-file value overrides this. Default 0.5.
_hints.scale_x: Custom mode only. Width multiplier relative to the aspect-preserving 'fit' size: 1 = whole media visible. Per-file value overrides this. A per-file `scale` sets BOTH axes, and giving BOTH per-file `scale_x` AND `scale_y` overwrites that `scale`. Default 1.0.
_hints.scale_y: Custom mode only. Height multiplier relative to the aspect-preserving 'fit' size. Per-file value overrides this. See `scale_x` for how it interacts with per-file `scale` / `scale_x`. Default 1.0.
_hints.flip_h: Custom mode only. Mirror the media horizontally. Per-file value overrides this. Default false.
_hints.flip_v: Custom mode only. Mirror the media vertically. Per-file value overrides this. Default false.
_hints.rotation: Custom mode only. Rotation in degrees around the media's center (any number). Per-file value overrides this. Default 0.
_hints.chroma_key: Green/blue-screen removal. Simple form: 'off' | 'green' (default) | 'blue' | 'weak green' | 'strong green' | 'weak blue' | 'strong blue' | 'custom'. Expert dict form still loads: {enabled, preset, exceptions, hue_range, saturation_range, value_range, despill}. 'custom' takes the hue/saturation/value ranges from the sibling keys chroma_hue_range / chroma_saturation_range / chroma_value_range (ignored for any other preset); otherwise the named presets apply. Applies to images AND videos. A per-file `chroma: false` skips filtering for that file; a per-file `chroma_key` preset overrides this preset for that file; changing a file's effective preset rebuilds its precache. Default 'green'.
_hints.autostart: true = register this app in the Windows login Run key on every launch (silent start at login). false = a boot launch (Run key + --autostart flag) removes the key and exits; a manual launch clears any stale key and keeps running. Default false.
_hints.show_console: true = keep a visible log terminal; false = hidden background. On the frozen exe the console is detached after config load (logs still go to app.log). Default false.
_hints.debug: Verbose logging to app.log (and to the console when it is shown). Default false.
_hints.kill_hotkey: Global keyboard shortcut that force-terminates the app (Windows only). Format 'ctrl+shift+alt+k' (modifiers + key joined by '+'; modifiers ctrl/shift/alt/win; key a-z, 0-9, f1-f12). Empty string = disabled. Dead man's switch for when overlays go haywire. Default 'ctrl+shift+alt+k'.
_hints.kill_notify: true = show a Windows notification when the kill switch fires, so the user knows why the app vanished (the balloon is drawn by a detached helper process and outlives the app). false = quit silently. Only relevant when `kill_hotkey` is set. Default true.
